findings.title: Residual: \S.{19,} near-stub bypass (R7-RESIDUAL-MIN-001 / R8-RESIDUAL-MIN-001 — carry-forward, no change)
findings.evidence: The \S.{19,} pattern requires first character non-whitespace (1 char) + at least 19 more characters of any kind (including whitespace). A description of 'x' followed by 19 spaces satisfies the regex. Unchanged from R7 and R8. Not introduced or worsened by fix-round-8. Deferred per R7 reviewer note: 'no fix strictly required for fixpoint given prose alignment'. Optional future hardening: change \S.{19,} to \S\S.{18,}.

findings.title: Residual: regex engine unspecified — U+00A0 NBSP behavior is engine-dependent (R7/R8 edge case — carry-forward, no change)
findings.evidence: The plan-doc specifies check-invocation-log-entry.sh implements the regex 'literally' but does not name the regex engine (grep -E vs grep -P vs Python). In POSIX ERE with LC_ALL=C, U+00A0 may not be treated as whitespace by \S, creating a potential NBSP-description bypass. Unchanged from R7 and R8. Not introduced or worsened by fix-round-8. Not blocking fixpoint; requires a U+00A0 description in a real TF row, which is unlikely in normal authoring.
findings.recommendation: Carry forward to 024B when the script is implemented — the implementer should document the regex engine and confirm U+00A0 behavior.
findings.outcome: CARRY-FORWARD (MIN — unchanged from R7/R8; not introduced or modified by fix-round-8)
